svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Editor tab · interval shoot · Color › WB keyframed · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift — the grading editor in its own resizable window (PhotoEditorWindowRequest scene in LetsLapseApp; default 1000×700 drawn here, min 720×480; the window chrome owns title and close, so there is no in-content back button or Done bar). REBUILT 2026-09-13 around the editor-controls redesign (Claude Design handoff “LetsLapse Editor slider organization”, boards 3b · 6c; spec sections 1–5, 9, 10): the seven-section always-open panel is gone; the grade is five GROUPS + Presets (App/EditorControls/EditorGroup.swift — Light: Exp · Con / High · Wh / Shad · Bl; Color: WB / Vib · Sat / Mixer; Effects: Tex · Clar / Vignette / Dehaze; Detail: Sharpen / Noise; Crop: aspect chips + Angle), each opened from a main button into ONE card of tool chips over an XY PAD (App/EditorControls/XYPad.swift) with two readouts, and closed by Revert (restores the snapshot taken when the panel opened) or Done (keeps). THIS FILE is board 6c on an INTERVAL shoot: Color › WB open with a KEYFRAMED Temp. TIMELINE (6c): with the Editor tab up on an interval shoot the strip leaves the rail and takes a 54 pt row under the media pane — padding 6 top / 16 sides, GradeTimelineView on its COMPACT metrics (26 pt play disc, 12 pt gap, 3 pt rail at primary 18 %, 11 pt moments with the 2 pt #C36A00 ring, 3×20 playhead in #1C1C1E drawn UNDER the moments, the elapsed bubble 8 pt above the row, 10 pt h:mm:ss end labels 2 pt under the track row) and the two 26 pt frame steps 6 apart at the right; on the light surface the discs are #E9E9EB with accent glyphs and the bubble is white with a shadow and black text. Track x=74…609. The INTERVAL badge (EditorMarqueeBadge — kind · length · frame count, 20 pt, black 50 %, 11 pt semibold) sits bottom-left of the pane at (12, 12). Staged by LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset: three owned-white moments at 10 / 52 / 86 % (6100 K / 7600 K / 5400 K with Exposure 0 / −0.20 / −0.50, Highlights −0.20 / −0.35 / −0.10, Shadows +0.10 / +0.18 / +0.30, Vibrance +0.12 / +0.38 / +0.10), the playhead at 30 % — so the keyframed fields are whiteMired, exposure, highlights, shadows and vibrance, and the values under the playhead are the eased blend of the first two moments (6715 K, Exposure −0.09, Highlights −27). The clock strings drawn (0:40:12, 2:14:00, 2 h 14 min · 58 frames) are the board's sample data; the 2026-09-13 captures ran on the bench shoot “Stack 2. 9. at 21:03” (1 h 34 min · 5660 frames, playhead 0:28:18). RAIL (3b / 6c): a FIXED 330 pt rail (railWidth, macOS) right of a hairline Divider — resizing the window grows the picture, never the controls. On the Editor page the whole rail scrolls, tab pill included: padding 14 top / 16 sides / 20 bottom, 12 between items. Top to bottom: (1) RailTabBar as a white capsule (padding 3, equal segments 2 apart, 13 pt semibold, the selected segment LL.accent with a white label) — Editor · Text · Frames · Masks, Frames only where frames do (availableRailTabs); (2) EditorGroupBar .macCard — a white card padded 6 holding six 46 pt cells spread edge to edge: 18 pt SF Symbol (photo.stack, sun.max, circle.lefthalf.filled, sparkles, triangle, crop.rotate), 9.5 pt semibold label, a 4 pt dot lit when the group holds a value or a travelling field, idle ink #6D6D72, the OPEN group on LL.accent 12 % with accent ink; a tap opens that group's panel and snapshots the grade, a tap on the open group leaves it open — closing is the panel's Revert / Done; (3) the open group's PhotoAdjustmentsPanel as a white radius-12 card padded 12 with 10 between rows: the header (title 13.5 semibold #6D6D72, the 6 pt dot when non-neutral, then Reset in accent text while non-neutral, the Revert pill #E9E9EB and the Done pill LL.accent, both 12 pt semibold, 23 tall, radius 7 — Done keeps the values and drops the snapshot, Revert restores it, both close), then the group's content; (4) MasksCard on its compact rows; (5) “Reset adjustments” 13 pt semibold accent, 4 in from the rail's content edge (the “Save these edits as a preset?” offer is the Presets group's own footer since 2026-09-13 and never follows it). Group card 62 tall at y=110; the panel card starts at y=184. TOOL CHIPS (EditorToolChips .light): one row, every chip the same width across the 274 pt card content, 6 apart, 30 tall, radius 9 — 18 pt EditorToolIcon (the handoff's icon set, drawn in SwiftUI), 11 pt semibold label (Exp · Con, High · Wh, Shad · Bl / WB, Vib · Sat, Mixer / Tex · Clar, Vignette, Dehaze / Sharpen, Noise), idle fill #F2F2F7 with #1C1C1E ink, the selected chip LL.accent 12 % with a 1.5 pt accent border and accent label; the label shrinks to 75 % before it truncates. The selection persists per group for the session. PAD (spec §2, XYPad .light): 274×170, radius 10, the crosshair at BOTH axes' neutral (black 25 %), a 24 pt LL.accent knob with a 2.5 pt white ring, the axis words 10 pt semibold white with a shadow inset 6 top / bottom and 8 at the sides; a drag writes both fields through the one binding in one write per tick, a double-click resets both (through the timeline where there is one); Tab focuses the pad and the arrow keys step it. Under it PadReadouts, 11.5 pt semibold: label #6D6D72, value black once moved, #6D6D72 at neutral, ACCENT when the field travels — with the 7 pt diamond (LL.amber, 1 pt LL.accent border, rotated 45°) after a travelling field's label and on a tool chip when either of its fields travels (treatment 1e-A). Settings › Advanced › Layout › “Use Pads in Editor” off (or LL_PADS=off) replaces every pad with its two slider rows, Y field first. WHITE BALANCE ROW (spec §8), above the pad: “White Bal.” 13.5 pt #6D6D72, a spacer, the AUTO button (wand.and.stars + “Auto”, 12 pt semibold accent on an #E9E9EB radius-6 pill, padding 3 × 9) and the illuminant menu — on the Mac the NATIVE pop-up (a white bordered pill with the system chevron; the board drew a 16 pt accent chevron square, the app takes the system control) whose closed label is the owned white: “Auto” while it is still the estimate, a named illuminant, else the Kelvin (“6715 K” here), and As Shot / Smoothed while nothing owns it. Auto = Kit AutoWhiteBalance's grey-world estimate of the frame under the playhead (≤ 256 px), written through ownWhite(kelvin:tint:) into the moment like a menu pick, so it keyframes identically; the menu: As Shot · Match This Frame · Smooth Auto WB · divider · Sunny / Cloudy / Fluorescent / Tungsten. THE WB PAD: Y is the white itself in mired presented negated (warm UP, top = warm; range 40…600 mired = 25000…1667 K), X is tint on the converter's ±150 axis (green left, magenta right); the gradients are the board's — vertical #3F7BD9 90 % (bottom) → clear → #F4B23A 90 % (top) over horizontal #4CAF50 80 % → clear → #D64BC6 80 %, over #E9E9EB on the Mac. The CROSSHAIR sits at the frame's OWN as-shot white (the neutral), not the pad's centre: at this frame ~6700 K and a tint of about +22, so it draws high and a little right of centre; while nothing owns the white the knob rests on it, the first move owns it, and here the sunset keyframes own a white that happens to sit on the same line — knob at (0.5, 0.81). Readouts: “Temp ◆ 6715 K” in ACCENT (whiteMired travels), “Tint 0” in black (an owned white counts as moved even at 0). WHITE BALANCE MODEL (2026-09-06, unchanged by the redesign): Temp and Tint are ABSOLUTE — a keyframe stores the white (PhotoAdjustments.whiteMired / whiteTint, interpolated in mired), two keyframes transition between two whites whatever the camera did in between, the white is a correction not a look (renders under Original, survives a preset, stripped from a saved preset, never turns a named preset Edited). LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset now stages exactly that: each moment OWNS a white (6100 / 7600 / 5400 K), which is what puts the ◆ on the Temp readout and the WB chip. STATES NOT DRAWN (desc-only): the menu open; “Auto” as the closed label; the Vib · Sat and Mixer tools (photo-viewer.mixer.svg draws the Mixer); a snapped moment (15 pt, white ring, accent halo); the long-press Delete bubble; the empty first-run strip (LL_KEYFRAMES=empty); the bad-frame tick row under the strip. DEVIATIONS FROM BOARD 6c, drawn as shipped: the header's Reset text button; the native pop-up in place of the board's accent chevron square. The inline preset offer no longer follows “Reset adjustments” (2026-09-13: it is the Presets group's own footer). Hooks: LL_EDITOR=latest LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=color:wb. Verified 2026-09-13 against the running Debug build (1× capture, light appearance forced per process; the bench shoot's title, clock and badge differ from the board's sample data drawn here).
